activity_statements.statement: distributes 1.5 million+ industrial-quality MRO (maintenance, repair, and operations) products including safety equipment, material handling tools, HVAC, electrical, and plumbing supplies to 4.5 million+ business customers worldwide
operates KeepStock on-site inventory management services providing vending machines and managed inventory replenishment programs inside customer facilities
provides consultative B2B sales, technical product expertise, and e-commerce ordering platform for industrial customers seeking to reduce total operating costs
operates approximately 245 US branches and 32 Canadian branches for local pickup and delivery of industrial supplies
operates Zoro.com as a consumer-facing online MRO marketplace subsidiary serving smaller businesses
generates approximately $17.9 billion in annual revenue serving customers in 53 countries with ~11,000 employees

name_reality_gap: Indexed as 'Manufacturing' but Grainger manufactures nothing — it is a wholesale distributor and B2B marketplace for industrial supplies. The confusion may arise because it sells to manufacturers, but its core competency is supply chain aggregation, inventory management, and consultative sales to industrial buyers.
